idea-plugin.name: GitVaulty
idea-plugin.description:
Edit authorized GitVaulty encrypted files in the native JetBrains text editor without creating plaintext repository files.

View GitVaulty on GitHub for source code, documentation, and issue tracking.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
3.0.0

  • Align the plugin and native runtime versions with the GitVaulty core version they bundle.
  • Move Stable-channel publication to the shared GitVaulty vX.Y.Z release tag.
  • Include GitVaulty 3.0.0 identity and signed-policy behavior in the native editor integration.

0.1.1

  • Refresh the signed native runtime and verify automated Marketplace updates.

0.1.0

  • Open authorized *.gitvaulty files in the native text editor.
  • Re-encrypt, verify, and atomically replace ciphertext on save.
  • Detect external ciphertext changes and prevent stale overwrites.
  • Show access, copy paths, reload, and explicitly export decrypted copies.
